name: EZ Bar Concentration Curl
steps: Sit on the bench with feet set wide and hold the EZ bar palms up on the inner bends.
Lean your torso slightly forward and brace the backs of both upper arms firmly against the insides of your thighs.
Curl the EZ bar smoothly upward toward your chest while keeping both elbows anchored against your thighs.
Lower the bar under full control until your arms are nearly straight before beginning the next repetition.
tips: Keep your shoulders steady and avoid rocking your torso backward as you lift.
Use your thighs as a stable brace rather than pushing your arms upward with your legs.
